evidence: The track begins at the Holdsworth car park at the end of Holdsworth Road.
It climbs to Puffer Saddle and down to the Kaitoke road end carpark, located along Kiwi Ranch Road.

doubts: No feature is at the Holdsworth car park (F1 is where the Lower Waiohine Track meets Waiohine Gorge Road, not Holdsworth Road), so the start ref is null. The Kaitoke end is taken as F3 because the text says the carpark is along Kiwi Ranch Road (F2 on Turksma Lane is close by). The Gentle Annie track is referenced to link L1 (Gentle Annie walk). Holdsworth Lodge is a bookable lodge near the road at the start; counted among huts though its bunks are not stated. The text says the track heads towards Mountain House Shelter but turns off to Totara Flats Hut before it is clearly reached; Mountain House Shelter left off the way. Passing the slip by the riverbank to Makaka Creek is only possible at low river; otherwise the all-weather track is used.
